The keeper wrote in the Harbour Log every evening, and on the night of the storm he underlined the word never twice before he closed the book.

The schoolteacher read the entry aloud. It said the Mariner had passed the point at midnight, without a light, and that the bell on the reef had rung three times.

Nobody in the village believed it until the morning, when the boats came back with a broken oar and a silver lamp that nobody could explain.
